operation_surface_rule.read: Read/list/detail/dashboard operations remain separate from mutation authority.
operation_surface_rule.mutation: Create/update/assign/approve/acknowledge operations require their exact action capability.
operation_surface_rule.export: Download/report/export operations retain separate derived-feature identities where disclosure differs.
operation_surface_rule.external: WorkSafe, pharmacy, portal, and other external-facing operations retain explicit authority and privacy boundaries.
operation_surface_rule.terminal: Close, discharge, seal, complete, dispose, and other terminal transitions remain bound to canonical records and independent prerequisites.

site_role_privacy_rule: Single tenant, multiple Sites: require the exact action capability, approved-Site scope, canonical record ownership, concealed foreign direct IDs, and applicable privacy or sensitivity rules. Global Site visibility broadens scope only and never replaces action authority.

hashes.normalized_decisions_rule: candidate_id|current_class|decision|comma_ordered_canonical_ids joined with LF as UTF-8, no trailing LF

disagreements: The 186-row discovery floor is not a final denominator; 32 scoped composites require splitting.
Care-plan review/sign-off is not an independent capability and merges into the Operations care-plan lifecycle.
Incident and safeguarding identities must be owned separately because their authority, sensitivity, direct-object concealment, and terminal workflows differ.
Site, respite, and HR complaint workflows remain owned by their canonical modules rather than a synthetic Complaints module.
CAP-WHISTLE-PROTECTED-DISCLOSURE remains M because no dedicated current-source owner was established.
CAP-SAFE-REPORT-AUDIT-EXPORT retains an explicit route/page ownership evidence gap.
evidence_count_basis: One normalized adjudication record per scoped candidate; unchanged anchors inherit the inputs and decisive changed-row anchors are materialized here.
evidence_limit: Static source identity only. No runtime, route execution, browser, benchmark, release, usability, production-readiness, or comprehensive-audit credit.
